insert into material_metric ( paper_id, material_key, metric_key, value_type, value_num, value_min, value_max, value_text, unit, qualifier, conditions, confidence, chunk_ids, create_time, update_time ) values
( #{item.paperId}, #{item.materialKey}, #{item.metricKey}, #{item.valueType}, #{item.valueNum}, #{item.valueMin}, #{item.valueMax}, #{item.valueText}, #{item.unit}, #{item.qualifier},
#{item.conditions}, #{item.confidence}, #{item.chunkIds, typeHandler=com.wong.collector.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.StringArrayTypeHandler}, now(), now() )
on conflict (paper_id, material_key, metric_key, md5(conditions::text), coalesce(value_num::text, value_text, '')) do update set value_num = excluded.value_num, value_min = excluded.value_min, value_max = excluded.value_max, value_text = excluded.value_text, unit = excluded.unit, qualifier = excluded.qualifier, confidence = excluded.confidence, chunk_ids = excluded.chunk_ids, update_time = now()
